# Copilot instructions

Repository conventions are in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root, and per-directory in
`<directory>/AGENTS.md`. Read the root file, and the one covering the code you are changing, before
proposing edits.

Skills live in `.agents/skills/`. Before the first edit of any file, open
`.agents/skills/implement-task/SKILL.md`. When a skill is named, open its `SKILL.md` rather than
guessing the steps.
